questions.q: Why should a Salesforce staging model usually filter on the IsDeleted flag?
options: Because Salesforce marks deleted records with a flag, and counting them inflates metrics like pipeline
Because IsDeleted is required for dbt to compile
Because deleted records cannot be joined to accounts
Because the flag controls field-level security
questions.explain: Deleted records can still appear in synced data if the flag is replicated; staging should exclude them so metrics stay accurate.

questions.q: What do custom Salesforce fields look like in raw synced tables, and what should staging do with them?
options: They arrive with a __c suffix; staging should rename them to clean names
They are dropped by every ingestion tool
They arrive as JSON blobs that can't be renamed
They keep no naming pattern, so no renaming is ever needed
questions.explain: Custom fields mirror API names and carry the __c suffix; the staging layer is the place to give them readable names.

questions.q: Which dbt test best protects against an admin adding or renaming a stage in Salesforce?
options: A not_null test on Id
An unique test on Amount
An accepted_values test on the stage field
A relationships test on Id
questions.explain: Picklist values are org-defined and admin-editable, so an accepted_values test flags new or changed values.

questions.q: Where should shared metrics such as win rate be defined in this architecture?
options: Separately inside each dashboard
In the mart layer or a semantic layer, once
In the raw tables
In the ingestion tool's schedule
questions.explain: Defining metrics once downstream of staging keeps every dashboard consistent and avoids metric drift.

questions.q: What is the safe approach to Salesforce formula fields in a warehouse?
options: Assume they always replicate and stay current
Never use any formula field
Only use them in Tableau
Verify replicated values, or recompute the logic in dbt from underlying fields
questions.explain: Whether formula fields replicate, and how fresh they are, depends on the ingestion tool, so verify or recompute.
